title: Published chat package imports a data subpath absent from the latest export map
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; package CI is independent of sign-in
preconditions: Use extension CI run 38257589484 with published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 and @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23.
The run reached unit tests against the current published package graph.
reproduction: Run extension CI run 38257589484 with @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 and @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23 in the dependency graph.
Observe four unit-test suites fail with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.
Trace the package error to published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62/dist/host/diagnostics.js importing @ai-matrx/data/net, a subpath not exported by @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23.
expected: The latest published shared-package graph exports every subpath imported by its dependents, so extension unit tests and mandatory CI pass. A stale or incompatible package graph is identified before it reaches release acceptance.
actual: Extension CI run 38257589484 failed four unit-test suites with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED because published @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 imports @ai-matrx/data/net, which is absent from the exports of @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23. Corrected shared chat source landed in aidream commit 5b6959d55de after the .62 publish, but no corrected chat package release has been published yet. The existing authorized aidream release run 38252153771 has its chat job in progress; this is not a successful release or retest.
cause: The published chat package was built before the source correction that removed its import of @ai-matrx/data/net, while the latest data package no longer exports that subpath. The extension consumes the incompatible published package graph.
severity: S2: required unit CI and release validation are blocked; no product runtime impact has been established.
priority: P0: unblock current CI and release validation by publishing and adopting a compatible latest package graph.
evidence: Published package evidence: @ai-matrx/chat@0.8.62 imports @ai-matrx/data/net; @ai-matrx/data@0.29.23 does not export that subpath.
next_action: Complete the already-authorized aidream release run 38252153771 and confirm a corrected @ai-matrx/chat package is published. Refresh matrx-extend @ai-matrx packages to latest and reconcile each package CHANGELOG Consumer action. Re-run the four affected unit-test suites, then full extension CI against the updated latest dependency graph. Keep the defect open until exact-current-graph CI passes; do not claim Chrome Web Store acceptance from CI or package publication.
